shard.basis: members of group module-adult-mental-health (origin publisher) in the current release (2023, 2024, 2025)

name: DSTNRV30
label: HOW OFTEN FELT NERVOUS PAST 30 DAYS

questions.text: During the past 30 days, how often did you feel nervous?

notes: The values in this section may be inconsistent with values for variables in other sections of the interview. Items in this section were edited when respondents legitimately skipped out of these items based on prior answers in earlier sections. Otherwise, variables in one section of the interview generally were not edited to make them consistent with variables in another section of the interview. This note applies to variables in this section marked by a1.
